Resumes only this account's connection; other users remain paused. Does not resend history.

findings.detail: Description of "check_source_availability" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_api_guide, read_feed, connect_publication_channel, get_publication_replacements, preview_publication_replacements, set_publication_replacements · Private data: account_status, update_settings, read_feed, configure_digest, list_publication_channels, connect_publication_channel, configure_publication, preview_publication_replacements, set_publication_replacements, update_ai_settings, preview_ai, open_account_action · Public sink: read_feed, list_publication_channels, configure_publication, get_publication_replacements, preview_publication_replacements, set_publication_replacements, preview_ai · Destructive: remove_source, configure_hashtag, get_digest_schedule, preview_digest_schedule, get_digest_run, set_publication_signature, get_publication_replacements.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_api_guide, read_feed, connect_publication_channel, get_publication_replacements, preview_publication_replacements, set_publication_replacements · Private data: account_status, update_settings, read_feed, configure_digest, list_publication_channels, connect_publication_channel, configure_publication, preview_publication_replacements, set_publication_replacements, update_ai_settings, preview_ai, open_account_action · Public sink: read_feed, list_publication_channels, configure_publication, get_publication_replacements, preview_publication_replacements, set_publication_replacements, preview_ai · Destructive: remove_source, configure_hashtag, get_digest_schedule, preview_digest_schedule, get_digest_run, set_publication_signature, get_publication_replacements

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
